newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia Jan-April retail sales up 3.77 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia Jan-April retail sales up 3.77 pct.

text.p: Colombia's retail sales, excluding vehicles and gasoline, rose 3.77 percent in the first four months of this year, compared with the same period in 1996, the National Statistics Department (DANE) said Thursday.
The rise in retail sales including vehicles and gasoline was 3.21 percent.
According to the DANE statement the biggest rise came in the sales of furniture and household electrical goods, up 15.5 percent compared with the January to April period last year.
Food, drink and tobacco sales rose 2.63 percent, clothing and shoe sales increased 8.4 percent and gasoline sales were up 1.07 percent.

The sale of hygiene, beauty and pharmceutical goods dropped 1.6 percent, hardware retail sales fell 5.6 percent, vehicle and spare part sales were down 1.16 percent and retail sales of non-specified other goods was down 2.66 percent.
